epic.title: EPIC-006: Manage Scope
epic.description: L'utilisateur modifie le périmètre d'un rapport existant (marchés, catégories, configuration LLM). Story 6.1: Manage Scope — Markets & Categories. Story 6.2: Manage Scope — LLM Configuration.

stories.title: [Story 6.1] Manage Scope — Markets & Categories
stories.description: As an Editor I want to add/remove markets and categories on an existing report So that I can adjust my analysis scope without creating a new report.
acceptanceCriteria: Given an Editor on the Settings/Manage Scope page, When they view the current scope, Then they see: list of countries (with Primary indicator), list of categories, enabled LLM engines, question counts per category/market, analysis metadata (creation date, last analysis, execution time)

Given an Editor adding a new market, When they save the change, Then quota is consumed (brand_markets_used + 1), the change is included in the next scheduled execution, UI shows 'Changes will take effect on next scheduled execution'
Given an Editor adding a new category, When they save, Then no additional brand_market quota consumed, included in next scheduled execution
Given an Editor modifying questions or adding competitors, When they save, Then changes persisted and applied on next run

stories.title: [Story 6.2] Manage Scope — LLM Configuration
stories.description: As an Editor I want to enable or disable LLM engines for an existing report So that I can adjust which AI engines are included in future analyses.
acceptanceCriteria: Given an Editor on Manage Scope, When they toggle an LLM engine, Then the change is saved and applied on the next scheduled execution And min 1 LLM must remain enabled
